P01.rationale: There is no founder or person used as a dominant human anchor; the page relies entirely on typography and abstract diagrams.

P05.rationale: The case studies are presented as text blocks without any client portraits or named visual anchors.

P07.rationale: A social-proof apparatus is present in the form of a large efficiency gain statistic (30-50%) and specific percentage data points within the steps.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present, specifically the giant '30-50%' figure used as a visual anchor.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations bound to numbers are present in the form of specific efficiency percentages and step-by-step metrics.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks and structured diagrams.

P13.rationale: There is no intentional background texture or atmosphere; the design uses flat, solid colors for backgrounds.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photos are used on this page, so this criterion does not apply.

P16.rationale: There is no device or product mockup shown; the visual elements consist of text and abstract process boxes.

N07.rationale: The imagery (abstract diagrams) looks generic rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content blocks and text.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without scrim because there are no background images to conflict with the typography.
